scope: Every event summary and principal date reviewed against sources; all border files scanned for integrity. This is not an independent certification of every historical frontier.
warnings: An independent source link and a valid year/point do not certify every detail. Ancient dates, representative locations and interpretive claims retain the qualifications in each entry.
Border geometries remain approximate source reconstructions; overlapping historical claims and all frontier segments have not been independently certified.
2025–2026 display the 2024 border snapshot; it is not a current conflict or occupation map.
